baseline_models.focus_anchor: The factitive verb صَدَّقَ is bound by بِ to the definite value-substantive الْحُسْنَىٰ.
baseline_models.mechanism: Correspondence between avowal, inward commitment, and what is the case turns the clause into active verification of goodness as a criterion, not mere repetition of a claim.

activation_trace.role: Truth as correspondence supplies the alignment among speech, inward commitment, and reality that makes the verb an act of verification.
Goodness or beauty opposed to ugliness supplies the definite criterion with which the verifier aligns.

changed_reading.after: He actively brought avowal and inward commitment into correspondence with the good as a governing criterion.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: صَدَّقَ can carry realization or fulfillment, while الْحُسْنَىٰ can name good action rather than only an abstract proposition.
baseline_models.mechanism: The two focus roots form a performative circuit: the good is confirmed by being realized as skillful or beneficent conduct.

activation_trace.role: Confirmation and fulfillment make verification something completed in deed.
Beneficent, skillful action gives the fulfillment a concrete mode and beneficiary.

changed_reading.before: He accepted the truth of the best.
changed_reading.after: He made the good true in conduct, confirming it by performing what benefits and exceeds bare fairness.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The focus directly joins صَدَّقَ to the superlative or limit-like الْحُسْنَىٰ.
baseline_models.mechanism: The material image of solidity and straightness combines with an utmost limit to produce a firm vector toward the best, so assent becomes durable orientation.

activation_trace.role: Solidity and straightness turn confirmation into a stable, non-crooked bearing.
The utmost effort or limit gives that bearing an extreme bestward endpoint.

changed_reading.before: He assented to a favorable outcome.
changed_reading.after: He set himself firmly and straight toward the utmost good, treating it as an orientation to inhabit.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: A branch of ص د ق names charity and relinquishment of a right, and the object الْحُسْنَىٰ can activate beneficent action.
baseline_models.mechanism: A derivationally wider but focus-internal reading makes confirmation materially costly: one verifies the good by loosening one's claim over a right or possession for another's benefit.

activation_trace.role: Charity and relinquished right supply the concrete act by which a claimed good can be verified.
Beneficent action directs the relinquishment toward enacted good rather than mere loss.

changed_reading.after: He certified the good by surrendering a claim and turning that release into benefit.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The same ص د ق inventory includes sincere friendship, while الْحُسْنَىٰ directly names what is good or beautiful.
baseline_models.mechanism: Confirmation becomes affiliation: the reader does not only judge goodness true but takes it as a sincere companion and object of loyal counsel.

activation_trace.role: Sincere friendship and counsel make truth a relation of loyalty rather than an isolated proposition.
Goodness and beauty supply the value with which the subject forms that sincere affiliation.

changed_reading.before: He judged the best to be true.
changed_reading.after: He entered sincere allegiance with the good, letting truth become a companioning loyalty.

context_deltas.mechanism: Alternating cover and disclosure turns correspondent verification into fidelity under changing visibility: concealment withholds evidence, while disclosure tests whether inner, spoken, and actual alignment endured.

activation_trace.role: Correspondence supplies the alignment that can persist or fail when visibility changes.
Goodness remains the criterion being held through both phases.
A covering that rises over and hides supplies the low-visibility phase of the test.
Disclosure and appearance supply the phase in which the prior alignment becomes inspectable.

structural_cues: The paired oath sequence in 92:1-2 places covering and self-disclosure before the focus.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies covering, disclosure, goodness, and correspondence; I infer that changing visibility tests rather than creates the truth of the good. A live alternative is that the pair only frames cosmic time and adds no epistemic mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Verification is a single moment of assent to visible good.
changed_reading.after: Verification is fidelity to the good across concealment and disclosure, with revelation exposing whether inward and outward alignment held.

context_deltas.mechanism: Measured formation followed by purpose-driven but divergent striving recasts focus-level firmness as selection of a trajectory: the good is the limit that prevents purposeful motion from dispersing.

activation_trace.role: Straight solidity supplies the stabilizing geometry of the chosen trajectory.
The utmost limit supplies the trajectory's bestward endpoint.
Measuring and proportioning supply an ordered field rather than undifferentiated motion.
Purposeful movement toward an object supplies directed human motion within that field.
Dispersion supplies the competing possibility that purposeful movements diverge.

structural_cues: The ordered creation pair in 92:3 is followed by the declaration of divergent strivings in 92:4, then by the focus sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies measure, goal-directed movement, divergence, straightness, and a limit; I infer that affirming the good selects and stabilizes one path through a field of possible strivings. The alternative is that creation and striving merely classify agents without making الْحُسْنَىٰ directional.

changed_reading.before: He accepted the best as a detached object of belief.
changed_reading.after: He fixed divergent striving into a measured bestward trajectory by treating the utmost good as its orienting limit.

context_deltas.mechanism: Giving and self-protective restraint immediately operationalize fulfillment and beneficence: confirmation is evidenced by what leaves the hand and by what the self refuses to expose to harm.

activation_trace.role: Fulfillment makes confirmation answerable to completed action.
Charity and relinquished right make giving a root-internal form of verification.
Beneficent action identifies the enacted quality of the good.
Handing something over supplies the outward transfer that realizes beneficence.
Placing the self within protection supplies disciplined restraint alongside outward giving.

structural_cues: The coordinated perfect verbs of 92:5 lead directly into the coordinated perfect verb صَدَّقَ in 92:6.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies transfer, self-protection, fulfillment, charity, and beneficent action; I infer that the preceding coordinated acts are the mode and evidence of confirmation. A live alternative keeps giving, restraint, and belief as three adjacent but independent virtues.

changed_reading.before: He mentally endorsed the good after separately giving and guarding himself.
changed_reading.after: His giving and restraint perform the endorsement: he makes the good credible by transferring benefit and governing exposure to harm.

context_deltas.mechanism: The firm bestward bearing of the focus is answered by an opening and a light, compliant motion; confirmation is not arrival but the alignment after which a route becomes traversable.

activation_trace.role: Straight firmness supplies a stable bearing before movement is eased.
The utmost good supplies the limit toward which the route runs.
Opening and ease after difficulty supply the route's newly traversable condition.
Lightness and compliance in motion supply the felt mechanics of facilitation.

structural_cues: The result clause فَسَنُيَسِّرُهُ immediately follows 92:6 and repeats the ي س ر root in both the facilitating verb and destination.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies firm orientation, an utmost limit, opening, and compliant movement; the result construction supports my inference that focus-level alignment enables traversability. The alternative is external reward: the path is eased after confirmation but is not mechanically shaped by it.

changed_reading.before: He affirmed a promised ease as an object.
changed_reading.after: He took a firm bestward bearing, and that alignment became the threshold at which the route opened and motion grew compliant.

context_deltas.mechanism: The exact denial mirror and the paired ease/difficulty results make confirmation a path-forming stance: acceptance and rejection of the same good feed back into opposite conditions of movement.

activation_trace.role: Truth as the contrary of lying supplies one pole of the mirrored stance.
Falsehood as the contrary of truth supplies the explicit negative pole.
The repeated goodness branch holds the object constant while the stance reverses.
Facilitation retains the opening mechanism but now governs the opposite destination.
Difficulty and severity supply the constricted destination paired with denial.

structural_cues: 92:9 mirrors 92:6 as كَذَّبَ بِٱلْحُسْنَىٰ, and 92:10 mirrors the result syntax of 92:7 while reversing the destination.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a truth/falsehood opposition, an unchanged object, and mirrored facilitation toward ease or difficulty; I infer a feedback loop in which stance toward the good shapes the path one can travel. The live alternative treats both paths as subsequent allocation rather than an intrinsic effect of stance.

changed_reading.before: Confirmation is a static belief whose opposite is simply disbelief.
changed_reading.after: Confirmation and denial are rival path-making postures: each relation to the same good progressively opens one mode of movement and constricts another.

context_deltas.mechanism: Accumulated property promises sufficiency but fails at the fall; this sharpens relinquished-right confirmation into release from a possession that cannot bear the possessor's weight.

activation_trace.role: Relinquishing wealth or a right supplies the focus-anchored alternative to retention.
Beneficent action makes release productive rather than merely dispossessive.
Sufficiency supplies the rescue-function that wealth is asked, and fails, to perform.
Acquiring and accumulating property supplies the retained mass whose adequacy is tested.
Falling into destruction supplies the terminal load-test under which retained wealth cannot suffice.

structural_cues: 92:11 directly asks what accumulated wealth can avail when its owner falls.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies retained wealth, expected sufficiency, destructive falling, and charitable relinquishment; I supply the ballast metaphor and infer that release before the fall reverses wealth's failed rescue-function. A live alternative is that wealth merely fails to rescue from an independently caused fall.

changed_reading.before: Confirming the good may include an abstract willingness to give.
changed_reading.after: Confirming the good loosens wealth's claim before retained property becomes useless ballast at the moment of collapse.

context_deltas.mechanism: Gentle direction joined to beginning, latter end, and eventual outcome expands الْحُسْنَىٰ from a detached prize into the quality and limit of an entire guided course.

activation_trace.role: Fulfillment supplies the realization of what a course promises at its end.
The utmost limit lets the good name the course's terminal measure.
Gentle indication toward a road or truth supplies the course's directional guidance.
Latter position after a first supplies one temporal boundary of the course.
Beginning and precedence supply the course's other temporal boundary.
Return to an eventual outcome connects first orientation with realized end.

structural_cues: 92:12 assigns guidance, and 92:13 immediately spans the latter and the first.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies guidance, temporal endpoints, outcome, fulfillment, and an utmost limit; I infer that الْحُسْنَىٰ can characterize a whole directed course rather than only its terminal reward. The alternative is a simpler promise-reading in which the good remains one future object.

changed_reading.before: He believed in a best result located at the end.
changed_reading.after: He trusted and enacted the goodness of a guided course whose beginning, direction, and eventual fulfillment belong together.

context_deltas.mechanism: Flame, turning away, being moved aside, and protection translate focus-level alignment into a spatial-thermal mechanism: relation to the good determines orientation and hence exposure.

activation_trace.role: Straight solidity supplies the stable orientation from which exposure can be understood.
Goodness supplies the pole toward which the stable orientation is directed.
Kindled fire supplies the hazardous field of exposure.
Pure, blazing flame intensifies that field from generic fire to engulfing heat.
Turning away supplies the negative change of orientation.
Removal and separation to the side supply spatial displacement from the hazard.
Repelling harm by protection supplies the function accomplished by that displacement.

structural_cues: 92:14-17 moves in sequence from blazing fire, through denial and turning, to being placed aside and protected.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies flame, turning, lateral removal, protection, straightness, and good; I infer that affirmation is an embodied orientation whose consequences include altered exposure. The live alternative is purely juridical placement after judgment, with no spatial mechanism internal to confirmation.

changed_reading.before: He held a correct belief that would later be rewarded.
changed_reading.after: He aligned himself with the good in a way that changed his bearing and, through that bearing, his exposure to an engulfing field.

context_deltas.mechanism: Transfer of property, purification, negated human repayment, and seeking the highest sustaining presence turn charitable confirmation into a non-exchange gift: its truth lies partly in refusing to convert benefit into leverage.

activation_trace.role: Charity and relinquishment of a right supply the focus-internal act of releasing a claim.
Beneficent action makes the released claim produce good for another.
Giving and delivery supply the outward transfer.
Possessed and accumulated property identifies what is transferred.
Purity and rectitude make motive-cleansing part of the transfer's mechanism.
Growth and increase preserve the paradox that relinquished wealth can produce a different kind of increase.
Repayment corresponding to an act supplies the exchange ledger that the syntax negates.
Seeking supplies the positive motive that replaces human recompense.
Face as self or essence makes the sought object presence rather than a transferable counterpayment.
Nurturing, repairing, and completing supply the sustaining relation toward which the gift is directed.
Height and elevation place that sustaining relation above the horizontal economy of repayment.

structural_cues: 92:19 negates a favor awaiting repayment, and the exception in 92:20 replaces that motive with seeking the face of the highest Lord.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies property transfer, purification and growth, a negated repayment ledger, seeking, presence, nurture, and height; I infer that refusal of human leverage is how this gift verifies the good. A live alternative restricts the motive contrast to this giver without making non-exchange intrinsic to صَدَّقَ بِٱلْحُسْنَىٰ.

changed_reading.before: He proved belief by donating wealth and could still treat the donation as a social credit.
changed_reading.after: He made the good true through a gift that releases both property and the claim to human repayment, purifying transfer from leverage.

context_deltas.mechanism: Future satisfaction gives fulfillment a delayed affective closure: one confirms the good before its felt adequacy arrives, so verification includes trust across temporal lag.

activation_trace.role: Fulfillment supplies the promise-to-realization arc across the temporal delay.
The utmost limit supplies the not-yet-reached horizon of the good.
Satisfaction opposed to displeasure supplies the eventual felt recognition of adequacy.
Mutual satisfaction keeps open a relational, not merely private, form of closure.

structural_cues: The final clause uses the future marker سَوْفَ, placing satisfaction after the focus and its enacted consequences.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies fulfillment, an utmost limit, future marking, and satisfaction; I infer that confirmation precedes and trusts the later felt closure. The live alternative is that satisfaction is only a reward and says nothing about the temporal structure of present verification.

changed_reading.before: He confirms a good already evident enough to satisfy him.
changed_reading.after: He commits to the good before satisfaction is available, trusting a fulfillment whose affective adequacy arrives later.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it transfers nearby sexed and terrain images into the feminine الْحُسْنَىٰ; it remains anchored in the focus's feminine form, its firmness branch, and its beneficent-action branch. Downstream prose must present it only as a material analogy in which firmness becomes generative, not as a lexical derivation of الْحُسْنَىٰ from femininity.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The feminine form الْحُسْنَىٰ receives صَدَّقَ's solidity without losing the focus root's capacity for beneficent action.

activation_trace.role: Solidity and straightness supply a conventionally hard material pole inside the focus.
Beneficent action requires the firm orientation to become productive for another.
The male branch's hardness and sharpness externalize the hard pole activated near focus-level solidity.
Easy fertile earth supplies a receptive and generative counter-pole rather than mere softness.

changed_reading.before: Truth toward the good is rigid correctness.
changed_reading.after: The focus can image a firmness that enters fertile receptivity and thereby becomes generative beneficence rather than sterile hardness.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the non-dominant ه د د mapping's child-rocking image from the context cue هدى; it remains anchored by focus-level firmness and pleasing good plus the explicit guidance cue. It should be rendered only as an embodied analogy of being settled into trust, never as a lexical gloss of هدى or صَدَّقَ.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: صَدَّقَ can supply firmness while الْحُسْنَىٰ supplies a pleasing quality, allowing the guided subject to be imagined as affectively settled into confidence.

activation_trace.role: Solidity supplies the stable condition reached by embodied settling.
Pleasing goodness supplies the attractive and reassuring quality of what is trusted.
Rocking a child to sleep supplies the non-dominant embodied image of gentle settling.

changed_reading.before: He intellectually verified a correct good.
changed_reading.after: He was gently settled into a firm, trusting relation with the good, as though guidance stabilized both judgment and affect.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This ecological reading is surprising because it combines a water-channel branch of giving with growth and a non-dominant nourishment branch of lordship; it remains anchored in the focus's charity and beneficent-action branches and in the giving-to-purify sequence. Downstream prose must call it a causal material analogy, not a translation of the surface words.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The charity branch of ص د ق and beneficent-action branch of ح س ن permit the focus to be modeled as releasing a resource so that good can grow.

activation_trace.role: Charity and relinquishment supply the release of a held resource.
Beneficent action supplies the good produced beyond the giver.
A watercourse and the opening of its way supply the channel through which a released resource moves.
Growth and increase supply the downstream effect of successful circulation.
Nourishment and development from the non-dominant mapped root supply the ecological function sustained by the flow.

changed_reading.before: He confirms good by losing wealth.
changed_reading.after: He confirms good by opening a channel: held resource is released, circulates, nourishes, and appears again as growth.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This reading is surprising because it carries the friendship branch of ص د ق into a sequence whose surface action is turning away and whose ending is satisfaction; it remains anchored in the focus's sincere-affiliation branch and the context's relational branches. It should be qualified as a relational subreading, not substituted for propositional confirmation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus root directly offers sincere friendship, allowing confirmation of الْحُسْنَىٰ to coexist as allegiance to the good.

activation_trace.role: Sincere friendship, affection, and counsel supply the focus-level relation of allegiance.
Goodness and beauty supply the value to which allegiance is given.
Turning away supplies the relational rupture that clarifies allegiance by its opposite.
Mutual satisfaction supplies a possible relational closure to sustained allegiance.

changed_reading.before: He assented to an impersonal proposition about good.
changed_reading.after: He allied himself sincerely with the good; turning away becomes relational rupture, while eventual satisfaction can be heard as restored reciprocity.

strongest_changes: The immediate giving-and-protection sequence changes صَدَّقَ from mental assent into verification performed through transfer, restraint, and beneficent action.
The mirrored denial and ease/difficulty clauses make relation to الْحُسْنَىٰ path-forming rather than static.
The later gift, purification, negated repayment, and seeking sequence sharpens confirmation into a non-exchange act that relinquishes both wealth and social leverage.
The end of the sequence adds temporal lag: confirmation precedes the satisfaction through which its promised good is eventually felt.
summary.what_was_special: The two-word focus sustained epistemic, performative, material, spatial, temporal, and relational readings at once. Its least conservative activations came from ص د ق branches of solidity, charity, and friendship, while context turned those latent images into path formation, shielding, purified transfer, ecological circulation, and allegiance without forcing them into one final interpretation.
remaining_uncertainties: The focus alone does not decide whether الْحُسْنَىٰ is primarily a proposition, a promised outcome, a governing value, an action-quality, or the limit of a whole course.
The charity and relinquished-right branch becomes strongly coherent in context, but its derivational distance from the verbal surface صَدَّقَ should remain visible.
Several causal arrows remain abductive: the context may depict consequences allocated after confirmation rather than mechanisms generated by confirmation.
The sexed-terrain, child-settling, irrigation, and friendship models remain live only as contained analogies; they should not be promoted to lexical glosses.
